vetSays.line: 🛡️ Cameron, Yuchen, Petra and Hannah met them at the door — 4 put down. Cameron, Yuchen, Petra, Hannah are hurt.
🛡️ Cameron, Paul, Lily and Petra met them at the door — 4 put down. Cameron, Paul, Lily, Petra are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Cameron just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Cameron, Paul, Lily, Prasun and Petra met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Cameron, Paul, Prasun, Petra are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Cameron just put down The Big Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Yuchen just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Prasun just put down The Congregation... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Prasun just put down The Eulogy... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
⚠ This one is different — bigger, and it didn't come alone. A Pack-leader veteran.
Amina strikes the Pack-leader Grief Counselor.

⚠️ 1 threats: Pack-leader Grief Counselor (×2) — all here, all now.
Your party: just you. You are outnumbered — fight like it.

The Pack-leader Grief Counselor shifts, seeking a clear lane.
The Pack-leader Grief Counselor falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Pack-leader Grief Counselor!
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Hermon just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Nora just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."
🛡️ Hermon and Nora met them at the door — 2 put down. Hermon, Nora are hurt.
⚠ This one is different — old, patient, unhurried — it has seen your kind before. An Elder veteran.
The Elder Ugly-Eyes stalks closer. It carves while it speaks — your name, a date, a line about potential. ‘Here lies—’ The chisel is the telegraph.
Hermon strikes the Elder Ugly-Eyes.
